author: Andreykor
view: E corner: SE street facade (left) and NE end facade (right), from E at eye level
notes: Quoins + '1947' cartouche with star, exposed brown rafter eaves, hipped metal roof, arched wicket of gate at right edge.

author: Andreykor
view: SW end: corner bay (arched ground window, glazed 2nd-floor bay, open balcony on 3rd), looking up
notes: Detail of the far-end bay element (mirror of Novikova 3 NW end).

author: Andreykor
view: E facade from inside the square, looking W, ~60 m, panorama stitched
notes: Shows central gabled bay + second (southern) gabled loggia bay at left; trees hide most of facade; square paths and fountain bed. Panorama distortion.

author: Andreykor
view: E facade (square side) central bay, straight-on from E at eye level ~25 m, behind round flowerbed/fountain
notes: Best straight-on of central stacked-loggia bay with gable+oculus, cornice modillions, doors, shop windows. 2015-09-16.

author: Andreykor
view: rear/courtyard (W) facade, entrance section, eye level looking up, close
notes: Plain rear facade: staircase window stack with half-level offset, round oculus with wide white ring, plain door surround, grey plinth, brick chimneys; balconies on adjoining section at right. Exact location on W facade uncertain.

author: Andreykor
view: courtyard (SW) side of a side building: projecting wing end (left) + recessed centre with balconies, looking along facade
notes: Gallery caption says Marshal Novikov 1 but the 3-storey buildings with exposed rafter eaves are a side building (probably Maksimova 8 courtyard (NW side) since Novikova 3 courtyard is in Flickr 18996369890; NOT verified; mirror twins). Paired windows with central colonnette in wing face.

author: Andreykor
view: gate between side building (left, with arched wicket) and Novikova 1 SE/NE end facade (behind), from the street side
notes: Scroll (volute) pylons in grey, arched wicket with cornice; Novikova 1 end facade with 2-storey bay window, balcony, arched side door.

author: Gennady Grachev from Moscow, Russia
view: SE end of Novikova 3 with rusticated corner quoins and '1947' cartouche; gate pylons and Novikova 1 end in background
notes: Heavily colour-filtered (Flickr). Shows cartouche detail, arch wicket with green roof, scroll pylons in white.

author: Gennady Grachev from Moscow, Russia
view: courtyard (SW) side of Novikova 3: projecting SE wing face (right) + recessed centre with balconies; camera GPS 55.80093,37.46959 (just N of Novikova 1), EXIF dest bearing ~340 deg
notes: Colour-filtered (Flickr). EXIF ImgDirection says ~160 deg but DestBearing ~340 deg; 340 fits the content (Novikova 3 courtyard). Balconies on scrolled consoles with ornamental railings, wing face with paired colonnette windows, crenellated brick chimneys, blue-grey metal roof.

author: Artyom Svetlov
view: from NNW across the street (camera 55.80181,37.46904 heading 157 deg): NE street facade receding left + NW end facade right, ~50-100 m
notes: Post-restoration (2025) colours: pale yellow walls, white trims with window hoods, brown rusticated portal; gables over portals; NW corner bay with arched window.

author: Andreykor
view: interior of museum (former Gastronom), shows a painting of Novikova 1
notes: Painting depicts the central stacked-loggia bay; artistic, low reference value.

author: Svetlov Artem
view: S/E corner: SE end facade (left) + NE street facade (right), 2011, from S at eye level (crowd)
notes: 2011 colours: reddish-brown quoins, red-brown plinth, grey window frames. Cartouche 1947.

author: Svetlov Artem
view: same corner as panoramio 54, slightly different framing
notes: Clearer view of SE end facade: 4 window bays, ground-floor window with hood; glazed wooden bay on street facade near corner.

author: Svetlov Artem
notes: Rusticated-block portal jambs with hood cornice; later metal canopy. Taken on the same 2011 excursion; building uncertain (sign 'кв 21-29' fits neither OSM flat count) — probably one of the side buildings.

author: unknown (photo of a stand in the courtyard, probably from Kurchatov Institute archive); uploaded by oboist
license: not stated (pastvu: rights of original holders; local reference only, do not redistribute)
